scope: Read-only methodological review; no arm outcomes analyzed

recommendation.amendment: Register timestamped amendment 002 before continuation; explicitly close only the four exact pending requests as controller-interrupted with outcome unavailable.
recommendation.raw_evidence: Preserve original pending raw bytes unchanged and hash-bound. Do not fabricate output, elapsed time, CLI events, return code, or provider/model failure. Never reissue the four unknown physical attempts.
recommendation.continuation: Resume only the 1080 unsent frozen calls, preserving frozen source, allocation, selection, scoring, feedback, caps, order, and old bytes; stop on any new error after draining the current bounded wave.
recommendation.classification: Unavailable observation due to controller interruption, distinct from model-wrong, extraction failure, and provider failure.
recommendation.analysis: Report 598 complete pairs and two unavailable pairs. Label the preregistered analysis on complete pairs available-case. Enumerate all 16 binary completions for four missing responses. Claim the primary positive difference plus exact two-sided conditional McNemar p<0.05 only if it holds for every completion; otherwise call the 600-pair result inconclusive.
recommendation.effect_bounds: For S equal to the observed sum of repair-minus-fresh differences over 598 pairs, the 600-pair mean difference lies in [(S-2)/600, (S+2)/600].
recommendation.bootstrap: Across all 16 completions, report the range of the preregistered 20000-draw paired bootstrap interval endpoints; do not select a completion by effect direction.

checks: Amendment 002 is timestamped before any continuation calls and references amendment 001 without replacing it.
Exception allowlist contains exactly the four pending request identities and maps to two full pairs, two requests per arm.
All 1080 intended unsent requests are identified, and dispatch selects no terminal or pending key.
Original frozen inputs, allocation, scoring, selection, feedback, request caps, and terminal raw response bytes remain unchanged.
Unknown pending raw bytes and hashes are preserved; any analysis overlay is separate and immutable.
Any new infrastructure error drains the current bounded wave then stops, with no retry or allowlist expansion.
Final report separates execution availability from response correctness and reports complete-pair analysis plus all-completion sensitivity.
risks: Missingness may be informative if requests in the interrupted boundary wave differ in runtime or order; complete-case results alone are insufficient.
Retrofitting terminal error rows risks fabricating unsupported telemetry; use an explicit availability overlay or archived raw pending row.
